parameters.name: DeliveredBy
parameters.description: The person who delivered the report.

parameters.name: DocumentType
parameters.description:
The document type. Valid values:
- 0: daily report
- 1: weekly report
- 2: monthly report
- 3: quarterly summary report
- 4: annual summary report
- 5: service summary report
- 6: emergency response report
- 7: vulnerability scan report
- 8: risk assessment report
- 9: other report
- 10: meeting report
- 15: classified protection assessment report.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: ReportType
parameters.description:
The report type. Valid values:
- 1: security service
- 2: emergency response
- 3: risk assessment
- 4: vulnerability scan
- 5: classified protection assessment.
